title: Evaluation preserved by the De Morgan transformation
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose every gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. For every Boolean input assignment, the circuit obtained by the De Morgan transformation has the same output as $C$.
